Direct forbidden-four-vertex graph enumeration agrees with the coefficient formula in 2<=m,n<=4, q<=3.

value.rationale: Complete multi-palette threshold class enumerator for minimal structured deletion of K_mn and exact palette-dependent sharp robustness thresholds. With m>=4, deleting up to n-2 edges incident at one vertex is invisible to two-colour counts, but any d>=2 is detected by three colours. This isolates a structural rather than merely numerical transition.
